title: Azure Security & Compliance: Build a Confident Cloud Foundation | Quadra
description: Quadra secures Azure environments end-to-end using Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Entra, Purview, and Azure Policy — delivering continuous protection, regulatory compliance, and cloud governance enterprises can rely on.
